title: Understanding Sampling Frame
text: Think about where Oski is conducting the survey and who might be missing from that location.

title: Defining Population of Interest
text: Consider who Oski wants to gather opinions from. Is it just the people at Memorial Glade or a broader group?

hintAnswer: No, it is not since not all attendees are necessarily at Memorial Glade.
title: Comparing Sampling Frame and Population
text: Which of the following best describes the relationship between Oski's sampling frame and population of interest?
choices: No, it is not, since all attendees are at Memorial Glade.
Yes, since all people in the population are the sample
